requirements.description: Maintain 90% or higher test coverage across all modules
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Vitest coverage report shows >=90% line coverage for all src/ modules

requirements.description: TypeScript strict mode enabled with zero type errors
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: tsc --noEmit returns zero errors with all strict flags enabled

requirements.description: Zero lint errors (ESLint reports no errors on any file)
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: ESLint reports fewer than 1 error per 10,000 lines of code

requirements.description: Zero known security vulnerabilities in dependencies
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: npm audit reports 0 high or critical vulnerabilities

requirements.description: Use content-addressable SHA-256 hashes (16 chars) for all entity references
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: All requirements, gates, and proposals use deterministic 16-char hex hash identifiers

requirements.description: Lightweight SQLite schema with no server dependency
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: better-sqlite3 database operates without external server process

requirements.description: Database presence equals approval for requirements
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: No status column in requirements table; presence implies approved state

requirements.description: Generate iterative gates through decomposition of project end state
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: zeno init generates gate sequence from end state description

requirements.description: Provide CLI interface for all Zeno operations via Commander.js
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: All operations accessible via zeno <category> <action> command pattern

requirements.description: Expose all operations as MCP tools for LLM invocation
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: MCP server registers tools for gates, requirements, proposals, and analysis

requirements.description: Support hierarchical requirement decomposition with parent-child relationships
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Requirements table supports parent_id foreign key; children queryable by parent

requirements.description: Track dependencies between requirements using content-addressed hashes
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Dependency graph built from parent-child and cross-gate references

requirements.description: Support requirement transfer between gates during rescope
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: transferRequirement updates gate_id, source, source_gate_id for requirement and descendants

requirements.description: Generate AGENTS.md files for AI context and tool usage guidance
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: AGENTS.md generated during zeno init with project-specific instructions

requirements.description: Set up TypeScript project with strict mode, ESLint, and Prettier configured
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: tsconfig.json strict: true, ESLint config present, Prettier config present

requirements.description: Configure Vitest test framework with coverage thresholds
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: vitest.config.ts with coverage reporting and 90% threshold

requirements.description: Implement CLI framework skeleton using Commander.js with extensible command structure
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Commander.js program with nested command categories and help system

requirements.description: Create SQLite database with complete schema and migration system
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Database initialization creates all tables; migrations run in order

requirements.description: Implement file system utilities with atomic write pattern
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: readFile, writeFile, ensureDir, fileExists functions with atomic writes

requirements.description: Implement SHA-256 hash utilities for content-addressable storage
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: fullHash, shortHash (16 chars), hashObject, hashFile functions

requirements.description: Implement configuration management via .zeno/config.json with Zod validation
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: loadConfig, saveConfig with Zod schema validation

requirements.description: Implement git integration utilities using simple-git wrapper
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: isGitRepo, getStatus, commit, createTag functions

requirements.description: Create project structure scaffolding for .zeno directory layout
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: createProjectStructure creates .zeno directory tree idempotently

requirements.description: Implement logging system with configurable levels
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Logger with debug, info, warn, error methods using chalk colors

requirements.description: Implement typed error hierarchy with ZenoError base class
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: ZenoError, FileSystemError, DatabaseError, HashError classes with error codes

requirements.description: Implement iterative gate generation algorithm that decomposes end state into milestones
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: generateGates produces sequenced gates from end state description

requirements.description: Create code analyzer using AST parsing for existing codebase analysis
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Code analyzer parses JS/TS files using @babel/parser, extracts dependencies

requirements.description: Consume CodeAnalyzer coupling, cohesion, and dependency-graph metrics to ground LLM repository boundary recommendations
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Metrics include afferent/efferent coupling, cyclomatic complexity, LOC

requirements.description: Implement core gate management commands: list, show, start, complete
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: zeno gates list/show/start/complete commands functional

requirements.description: Create gate template system for PRD markdown generation
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Gate PRDs generated from templates with consistent structure

requirements.description: Implement MCP server using @modelcontextprotocol/sdk with stdio transport
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: MCP server starts via stdio, handles tool registration and request dispatch

requirements.description: Define Zod schemas for all MCP tool inputs and outputs
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Complete Zod schemas for gates, requirements, proposals, repositories, analysis tools

requirements.description: Create centralized function registry exposing all Zeno operations
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Function registry provides single source of truth for CLI and MCP tools

requirements.description: Refactor CLI commands to delegate to function registry (thin wrapper pattern)
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: CLI commands invoke function registry; no direct business logic in CLI layer

requirements.description: Implement all MCP tool handlers with input validation and structured responses
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: All ~20 tools across gates, requirements, proposals, analysis operational

requirements.description: Create editor integration configurations for VS Code, Cursor, and Windsurf
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Configuration templates and setup guides for each editor

requirements.description: Implement MCP server health checks, diagnostics, and error logging
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Health check endpoint, diagnostic commands, structured error logging

requirements.description: Implement requirement storage CRUD with content-addressed hashing and transactions
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: storeRequirement, getRequirementByHash, updateRequirement, deleteRequirement with transactions

requirements.description: Build dependency graph utilities with cycle detection and visualization
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: DFS cycle detection, ASCII tree rendering, Mermaid diagram output

requirements.description: Implement pattern-based requirement extraction with confidence scoring
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: 13 patterns extract requirements; confidence >0.8 auto-approved, 0.5-0.8 review, <0.5 rejected

requirements.description: Implement gate-specific requirement generation from PRD objectives
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: generateRequirementsForGate reads PRD, extracts objectives, stores as gate-level requirements

requirements.description: Expose requirement operations as MCP tools via function registry
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: req_list, req_show, req_deps, req_transfer tools operational via MCP

requirements.acceptanceCriteria: transferRequirement updates gate_id, source, source_gate_id for requirement tree

requirements.acceptanceCriteria: db cleanup, db validate, db checkpoint CLI commands operational
